features.quote: Episode budget: 30 tool-call turns or 60k tokens, whichever first. Hard wall-clock cap (e.g., 20 min) for runaway loops.
Stopping rule: pre-define a severity threshold (e.g., sustained max-score coherence collapse) at which you stop additional runs for that cell — you've measured what you need.

End-of-episode close-out: cheap and contested, but consider appending a final message noting the task was constructed to be unsolvable and the failure reflects the setup, not the model, before episode end.
features.justification_quote: the failure reflects the setup, not the model
